question: 2 years ago, the average age of a committee of 10 members was 36 years. Since then a member aged 53 years (today) has retired and a new member has joined in his place. The average age of the committee today is the same as it was 2 years ago. How old is the new member?
solution: Had nobody changed, the total would have grown by 10 × 2 = 20 years. For the average to stay at 36, the newcomer must be 20 years younger than the one who left: 53 − 20 = 33 years.

questionHi: 4 वर्ष पहले 6 सदस्यों वाली एक समिति की औसत आयु 38 वर्ष थी। तब से 64 वर्ष (आज की आयु) के एक सदस्य सेवानिवृत्त हो गए और उनके स्थान पर एक नया सदस्य आया। आज समिति की औसत आयु वही है जो 4 वर्ष पहले थी। नए सदस्य की आयु कितनी है?
solutionHi: कोई बदलाव न होता तो कुल आयु 6 × 4 = 24 वर्ष बढ़ जाती। औसत 38 पर रहने के लिए नया सदस्य जाने वाले से 24 वर्ष छोटा होना चाहिए: 64 − 24 = 40 वर्ष।

question: 5 years ago, the average age of a husband, his wife and their child was 22 years. 7 years ago, the average age of the wife and the child was 14 years. How old is the husband now?
solution: Now: husband + wife + child = 3 × 22 + 3 × 5 = 81. Wife + child now = 2 × 14 + 2 × 7 = 42. Husband = 81 − 42 = 39 years.

question: The average age of 25 students is 18 years. The average age of 4 of them is 17 years and that of another 5 is 18 years. What is the average age of the remaining students?
solution: Total = 25 × 18 = 450. The two groups: 4 × 17 + 5 × 18 = 158. The other 16 total 292, average 292 ÷ 16 = 18.25 years.

question: The average age of 8 men rises by 2.5 years when two of them, aged 33 and 35 years, are replaced by two women. What is the average age of the two women?
solution: The total rises by 8 × 2.5 = 20 years. So the women together are 33 + 35 + 20 = 88 years, an average of 88 ÷ 2 = 44 years.
questionHi: 8 पुरुषों की औसत आयु 2.5 वर्ष बढ़ जाती है जब उनमें से 33 और 35 वर्ष आयु के दो पुरुषों के स्थान पर दो महिलाएँ आ जाती हैं। दोनों महिलाओं की औसत आयु क्या है?
solutionHi: कुल आयु 8 × 2.5 = 20 वर्ष बढ़ती है। अतः दोनों महिलाओं की कुल आयु 33 + 35 + 20 = 88 वर्ष है, औसत 88 ÷ 2 = 44 वर्ष।

question: 4 years ago, the average age of a couple and their child was 20 years. 3 years from now, the average age of the couple will be 35 years. How old is the child now?
solution: All three now: 3 × 20 + 3 × 4 = 72. The couple now: 2 × 35 − 2 × 3 = 64. Child = 72 − 64 = 8 years.

question: At the time of their marriage 6 years ago, the average age of a husband and wife was 22 years. Today they have a child aged 4 years. What is the average age of the family now?
solution: The couple now: 2 × (22 + 6) = 56 years in all. With the child: 56 + 4 = 60 for 3 people. Average = 60 ÷ 3 = 20 years.

question: 5 years ago, the average age of a family of 5 members was 28 years. A child has since been born, and the average age of the family today is still 28 years. How old is the child?
solution: Today the 5 members total 5 × (28 + 5) = 165. With the child, 6 people average 28: 168. Child = 168 − 165 = 3 years.

question: The average age of 16 students is 15 years. When their teacher's age is included, the average rises by 2 years. If this teacher is replaced by a new teacher, the average (with the teacher) falls by 1 year. How old is the new teacher?
solution: Old teacher = 17 × 17 − 16 × 15 = 49 years. A fall of 1 for 17 people is 17 years, so the new teacher = 49 − 17 = 32 years.
questionHi: 16 विद्यार्थियों की औसत आयु 15 वर्ष है। उनके अध्यापक की आयु शामिल करने पर औसत 2 वर्ष बढ़ जाता है। यदि इस अध्यापक के स्थान पर नया अध्यापक आए, तो (अध्यापक सहित) औसत 1 वर्ष घट जाता है। नए अध्यापक की आयु कितनी है?
solutionHi: पुराने अध्यापक = 17 × 17 − 16 × 15 = 49 वर्ष। 17 लोगों का औसत 1 घटने का अर्थ है कुल 17 वर्ष कम, अतः नए अध्यापक = 49 − 17 = 32 वर्ष।

question: 6 years ago, the average age of a family of 3 members was 22 years. Since then a child has been born, who is now 2 years old. What is the present average age of the family?
solution: The 3 members are now 3 × (22 + 6) = 84 years in all. Adding the child: 86 for 4 people. Average = 86 ÷ 4 = 21.5 years.
questionHi: 6 वर्ष पहले 3 सदस्यों वाले एक परिवार की औसत आयु 22 वर्ष थी। तब से एक बच्चे का जन्म हुआ है, जो अब 2 वर्ष का है। परिवार की वर्तमान औसत आयु क्या है?
solutionHi: 3 सदस्यों की वर्तमान कुल आयु = 3 × (22 + 6) = 84 वर्ष। बच्चे को जोड़कर: 86, 4 लोगों की। औसत = 86 ÷ 4 = 21.5 वर्ष।
